safety: All scenario execution MUST be isolated from normal saved progress, wallet, purchases and user settings. No PIN-only protection; BERRY_INTERNAL_QA compile gate. Mark actual status only after running tests. D0 proof 6/6 on iPhone 16e simulator covers ONLY two fully implemented scenarios; do not imply full 48 scenario coverage or physical-device validation. D0b six scenarios are separate value-type policy implementations and remain unaccepted until named simulator results and owner physical UI tests are verified. GitHub Actions #44864274159 attempt 2: D0/D0b selected 17/17 XCTest green, with safe Release compile. Do not equate these mock policy fixtures with full production purchase/save or physical iPhone acceptance.
rules: Every new mechanic requires a scenario coverage entry.
No scenario may report pass without result and test artifact.
Do not modify production saves or reward history.
Use deterministic RNG and injected clock; never change device clock.
CI stress tests are not a substitute for physical iPhone 16e touch QA.
